Refined Requirement 26 (Stage 1 and Stage 2 Codebase Audit). Preserved the requirement number, title, and user story. Addressed the following critical gaps:

1. Defect traceability (P1): amended criterion 3 to add a unique defect identifier and the inspection category, so defect records can be linked to their remediations in criteria 5-7.
2. No-defect case structure (P1): amended criterion 2 to clarify each category must hold either structured defect entries or an explicit "no defect found" record.
3. Remediation gating by identifier (P1): amended criterion 5 to tie the remediation precondition to the recorded unique defect identifier.
4. Regression verification observability (P0): amended criterion 6 to require verifying and recording that Requirements 1-25 still hold, and amended criterion 7 to make the regression check gate audit completion with retained failing-criterion details.

No implementation details, technology names, or message text were added. All criteria follow EARS patterns (Ubiquitous, Event-driven WHEN, Unwanted-event IF-THEN). Criteria 1 and 4 were preserved unchanged. No new criteria were added (stayed within budget by amending existing criteria). The complete refined requirement markdown is provided in the main response, ready to replace the original section in requirements.md.
